pendingUx.fallback: The existing settleInitialPlacement graph is published first and remains usable while the Worker operation runs.
pendingUx.provisionalGraph: Only the graph surface receives graph--frontier-provisional opacity/saturation styling while the operation is pending.
pendingUx.status: A polite live status exposes pending, cancelled, stale, and bounded-fallback outcomes.
pendingUx.cancel: A DEV staging-only Cancel action invalidates and terminates the active operation; it does not mutate Dataset or coordinates.
pendingUx.chrome: Application chrome is not globally disabled; existing focus-visible styling remains available.
pendingUx.locale: Pending and terminal status/cancel labels are provided for EN and JA.

lifecycle.snapshot: The adapter receives an immutable semantic graph/config snapshot with operationId, generation, and session identity.
lifecycle.success: Only a current complete finite selected-position result is adopted into render-only positions and viewport fit.
lifecycle.cancel: Cancellation terminates the Worker and publishes no result; the usable fallback remains.
lifecycle.failure: Worker failure or invalid/partial output resolves to bounded fallback without partial adoption.
lifecycle.stale: Replacement, mutation, workspace exit, unmount, and operation invalidation prevent late publication.
lifecycle.authority: Stored/mixed Coordinates, Dataset, persistence, dirty-state, routing, labels, and Self-loop authority remain outside the staged operation.
